EmailTemplate.subject: Important Information Regarding HigherEd Points
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
This letter serves as formal notification that Flywire is discontinuing the HigherEd Points program.
As an immediate action, we ask that you remove all instances of HigherEd Points from your website and payer communication materials.
While we regret any inconvenience this announcement may cause, we look forward to your continued interest in our solutions and working together to drive student success.
Please contact us through our Flywire Client Support Hub <[[http://clientsupport.flywire.com]]>, if you have any questions or need additional support. Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
